components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Quiet rounded navigation that becomes a lifted paper surface when active.
components.html: Stories18
components.css: .ds-nav-item{min-height:40px;border-radius:12px;color:#5a676b;background:transparent;padding:0 11px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;text-decoration:none;font:600 13px 'Albert Sans',sans-serif;transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease}.ds-nav-item svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-nav-item small{margin-left:auto;color:#7f8984;font:500 10px 'Source Code Pro',monospace}.ds-nav-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);color:#0f2638}.ds-nav-item-active{background:#fffdf9;color:#0f2638;box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(53,42,30,.05)}.ds-nav-item-active svg{color:#ff6f61}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(255,111,97,.32);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Search Control
components.description: A low-contrast command-search control with a paper keyboard cue.
components.css: .ds-search{width:320px;height:38px;padding:0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:#6a777b;background:#f1ebe3;border:0;border-radius:11px;text-align:left;font:400 12px 'Albert Sans',sans-serif;transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease}.ds-search svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round}.ds-search kbd{margin-left:auto;font:500 9px 'Source Code Pro',monospace;border:1px solid #d7cfc5;border-radius:5px;padding:2px 5px;background:#fffdf9}.ds-search:hover{background:#ece4da;color:#0f2638}.ds-search:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(255,111,97,.32);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Route Marker
components.description: The coral numbered stop that anchors progression and selection.
components.css: .ds-route-marker{width:47px;height:47px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:#ff6f61;border:1px solid #ff6f61;color:#fff;font:600 11px 'Source Code Pro',monospace;transition:background .24s ease,color .24s ease,transform .24s ease}.ds-route-marker:hover{transform:scale(1.06)}.ds-route-marker:active{transform:scale(1)}.ds-route-marker:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(255,111,97,.32);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Story Card
components.description: The primary behavior chapter: spacious paper, semantic hierarchy, and quiet elevation.
components.css: .ds-story-card{overflow:hidden;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 34px rgba(53,42,30,.07);transition:box-shadow .22s ease,transform .22s ease}.ds-story-card:hover{box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(53,42,30,.11);transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-story-main{width:100%;min-height:150px;padding:21px 64px 20px 23px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;background:transparent;border:0;color:#0f2638;text-align:left;font-family:'Albert Sans',sans-serif}.ds-step-type{color:#a54f46;font-size:10px;font-weight:700}.ds-step-system{color:#6f7e78;font:500 10px 'Source Code Pro',monospace}.ds-story-main strong{grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:16px;font-size:20px;line-height:1.15;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-step-summary{grid-column:1/-1;max-width:52ch;margin-top:7px;color:#4b5b66;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}.ds-step-action{grid-column:1/-1;margin-top:17px;color:#587068;font-size:11px;font-weight:600}.ds-story-main:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(255,111,97,.32);outline-offset:-3px}

components.css: .ds-local-expansion{background:#f0f7f3;border-top:1px solid #dcece5;color:#355248;font-family:'Albert Sans',sans-serif}.ds-expansion-head{min-height:44px;padding:0 22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:10px}.ds-expansion-head strong{font-weight:700}.ds-expansion-head span{color:#657b73;font:500 10px 'Source Code Pro',monospace}.ds-local-expansion ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0 22px 15px}.ds-local-expansion li{min-height:40px;border-top:1px solid #dce9e3;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-size:11px}.ds-local-expansion li span{width:20px;color:#73a596;font:500 9px 'Source Code Pro',monospace}

components.name: Source Trace
components.description: Compact implementation evidence with a calm mint icon field.
components.css: .ds-source-trace{width:100%;padding:15px;border:0;border-radius:14px;background:#fffdf9;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(53,42,30,.07);display:grid;grid-template-columns:29px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:11px;align-items:center;color:#61726d;text-align:left;font-family:'Albert Sans',sans-serif;transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}.ds-source-trace svg{width:29px;height:29px;padding:6px;border-radius:9px;background:#d8eee6;color:#477d6e;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ds-source-trace small,.ds-source-trace strong,.ds-source-trace em{display:block}.ds-source-trace small{color:#7d8984;font-size:9px;font-weight:600}.ds-source-trace strong{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-top:4px;color:#0f2638;font:500 10px 'Source Code Pro',monospace;white-space:nowrap}.ds-source-trace em{margin-top:3px;color:#82908a;font:normal 500 9px 'Source Code Pro',monospace}.ds-source-trace b{font-size:18px;font-weight:400}.ds-source-trace:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 10px 32px rgba(53,42,30,.09)}.ds-source-trace:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(255,111,97,.32);outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: Storyline is a gentle path through complexity. Warm paper-like surfaces and generous whitespace reduce cognitive pressure, while a continuous coral route gives the reader a dependable narrative thread. Pale mint fields reveal supporting behavior and source context without competing with the story. The system is calm, friendly, intelligent, and quietly technical; product behavior is always encountered before implementation evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory, layered paper, deep ink navy, sparse coral, and calm mint.
A vertical story route as the dominant form and reading order.
Progressive disclosure from story step to semantic operations to source trace.
Ambient elevation, thin warm rules, rounded frames, and simple line icons.
Spacious humanist typography with monospace reserved for implementation detail.

rules.name: The Coral Path Rule
rules.body: Coral communicates progression, selection, or a key action; it is not a general surface fill.

rules.name: The Supporting Mint Rule
rules.body: Mint indicates context, evidence, completion, or semantic detail. It never replaces coral as the narrative path.

rules.name: The Technical Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve monospace for paths, line numbers, keyboard shortcuts, counts, and compact system metadata.

rules.name: The Ambient-Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows stay broad, warm, and low-opacity; never use hard, dark, or decorative elevation.

dos: Do preserve the vertical story as the primary reading order.
Do lead with human outcomes, then disclose semantic operations and source evidence locally.
Do use coral sparingly for the path, selection, focus, and key progression cues.
Do use mint for supporting detail, completion, readiness, and evidence icon fields.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't turn the experience into a dense technical dashboard, data model, or call graph.
Don't imply causal dependencies with decorative arrows when they are only metadata.
Don't use literal code brackets, terminal aesthetics, generic sparkles, gradients, stock-office imagery, or generic AI imagery.
Don't use coral as a broad background color or mint as the primary action color.
Don't spread monospace across headlines or explanatory prose.
Don't add hard shadows, heavy borders, sharp cards, or dense all-caps labels.
